name: Platform Sidebar Navigation
description: Left sidebar layout with collapsible navigation (Principal, Proyectos, Administración sections), mobile hamburger drawer, visible theme toggle (light/dark) with a persisted choice after reload, profile link, and logout. Personalized palettes choose readable foregrounds; cover images retain theme surfaces and teleported customization follows the active document mode. Removing a custom cover clears the saved profile image and survives reload; gallery selection replaces the uploaded cover. Shared Platform controls retain their existing activation and custom layout through the base button semantics. Initials in the desktop sidebar, mobile drawer and header retain the white-on-brand-green pair independently of a personal primary palette; account labels keep consistent icon spacing and pending project navigation remains disabled.
